about: Fresh-load default of every user-facing composer preference (keys of defaultPrefs in apps/web/src/store.ts). Each entry with an official counterpart must name an official capture that is already in the repo, a pixel to sample, and the colours that mean on and off. official-defaults.spec.ts decodes the capture and fails when the recorded default disagrees with the capture, when a defaultPrefs key has no entry, or when our fresh-load render disagrees.
